sculpt_stele_earth.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_stele_earth.notes: Page-trial marker stele (earth): tapering arched slab, capstone, worn foot stone, raised roundel with the element sigil (part Glow: the game's sigil glow), carved letters, lichen, moss. Vertex colours on every LOD, no textures; merged per material into the site (gameplay/wilds-pages.js).
